title: Safeguard Validation Management Policy
definition: Maintain a cybersecurity safeguard validation (audit) plan that documents the assessments the organization will perform to validate the quality of its cybersecurity safeguards.

title: Safeguard Validation Management Policy
definition: Ensure the cybersecurity safeguard validation (audit) plan is a multi-year plan that regularly addresses all scopes the organization should assess.

title: Safeguard Validation Management Policy
definition: Ensure the cybersecurity safeguard validation (audit) plan establishes criticality rankings for each assessment scope in the plan.

title: Safeguard Validation Management Policy
definition: Ensure the cybersecurity safeguard validation (audit) plan defines who should perform each assessment scope in the plan.

title: Safeguard Validation Management Policy
definition: Ensure the cybersecurity safeguard validation (audit) plan includes each cybersecurity penetration testing scope that should be assessed regularly.

title: Safeguard Validation Management Policy
definition: Ensure the cybersecurity safeguard validation (audit) plan includes software application penetration tests.

title: Safeguard Validation Management Policy
definition: Ensure the cybersecurity safeguard validation (audit) plan includes red team cybersecurity assessments.

title: Safeguard Validation Management Policy
definition: Ensure the cybersecurity safeguard validation (audit) plan defines where cybersecurity penetration testing should be performed only against test systems due to system sensitivity.

title: Safeguard Validation Management Policy
definition: Ensure the cybersecurity safeguard validation (audit) plan defines how cybersecurity penetration testing should use vulnerability scanners as part of the assessments.

title: Safeguard Validation Management Policy
definition: Ensure the cybersecurity safeguard validation (audit) plan defines when cybersecurity penetration testing should be documented in machine-readable formats, such as SCAP.

title: Safeguard Validation Management Policy
definition: Ensure the cybersecurity safeguard validation (audit) plan defines how the organization will monitor user accounts during cybersecurity penetration tests.

title: Safeguard Validation Management Policy
definition: Ensure the organization's leadership stakeholders regularly approve the cybersecurity safeguard validation (audit) plan.

title: Safeguard Validation Management Policy
definition: Ensure the organization's leadership stakeholders regularly allocate and assign resources to the safeguard validation (audit) plan and complete each assessment according to the defined schedule.

title: Safeguard Validation Management Policy
definition: Document the results of each cybersecurity assessment in a central software platform, such as a Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) tool.

title: Safeguard Validation Management Policy
definition: Track the progress of each cybersecurity assessment in a central software platform, such as a Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) tool.

title: Safeguard Validation Management Policy
definition: Regularly report the results of each cybersecurity assessment to the organization's leadership stakeholders.
